meta.title: Once More Unto The Breach
meta.description: Mankind is skilled at managing risks, yet there are precious things worth taking risks for.

units.rawText: Some time ago.
units.displayText: Some time ago.

spans.text: Some time ago.

units.rawText: Some of them are young, some of them are old. Some of them have faces filled with anger and indignance at their death, while others are merely resentful at their painful expiration.
units.displayText: Some of them are young, some of them are old. Some of them have faces filled with anger and indignance at their death, while others are merely resentful at their painful expiration.

spans.text: Some of them are young, some of them are old. Some of them have faces filled with anger and indignance at their death, while others are merely resentful at their painful expiration.

units.rawText: Chris' heart aches as he runs past these silent gravestones.
units.displayText: Chris' heart aches as he runs past these silent gravestones.

spans.text: Chris' heart aches as he runs past these silent gravestones.

units.rawText: Dad... Dad...
units.displayText: Dad... Dad...

spans.text: Dad... Dad...

units.rawText: Tears fill Chris' eyes. After circling around mounds of debris and evading pursuit, he finally finds himself in front of the hairdresser's.
units.displayText: Tears fill Chris' eyes. After circling around mounds of debris and evading pursuit, he finally finds himself in front of the hairdresser's.

spans.text: Tears fill Chris' eyes. After circling around mounds of debris and evading pursuit, he finally finds himself in front of the hairdresser's.

units.rawText: DAD! (wails)
units.displayText: DAD! (wails)

spans.text: DAD! (wails)

units.rawText: Lieutenant Izka's face is unrecognizable, but the medals adorning his chest still shine defiantly.
units.displayText: Lieutenant Izka's face is unrecognizable, but the medals adorning his chest still shine defiantly.

spans.text: Lieutenant Izka's face is unrecognizable, but the medals adorning his chest still shine defiantly.

units.rawText: Chris carefully removes the medal, then throws himself onto the blackened half-torso, unable to hold back his sorrow.
units.displayText: Chris carefully removes the medal, then throws himself onto the blackened half-torso, unable to hold back his sorrow.

spans.text: Chris carefully removes the medal, then throws himself onto the blackened half-torso, unable to hold back his sorrow.

units.rawText: Suddenly, a pair of strong hands grab him.
units.displayText: Suddenly, a pair of strong hands grab him.

spans.text: Suddenly, a pair of strong hands grab him.

units.rawText: Got you at last, you damn brat!
units.displayText: Got you at last, you damn brat!

spans.text: Got you at last, you damn brat!

units.rawText: Shut the hell up and get him back to the base! My balls are freezing off!
units.displayText: Shut the hell up and get him back to the base! My balls are freezing off!

spans.text: Shut the hell up and get him back to the base! My balls are freezing off!

units.rawText: Why do we even have to capture this brat, anyway? We should just give him two in the back of the head and be done with it!
units.displayText: Why do we even have to capture this brat, anyway? We should just give him two in the back of the head and be done with it!

spans.text: Why do we even have to capture this brat, anyway? We should just give him two in the back of the head and be done with it!

units.rawText: Hell if I know what the brass is thinking! Anyway, we don't have to like it, we just have to do it!
units.displayText: Hell if I know what the brass is thinking! Anyway, we don't have to like it, we just have to do it!

spans.text: Hell if I know what the brass is thinking! Anyway, we don't have to like it, we just have to do it!

units.rawText: Leggo! Hey! Leggo of me!
units.displayText: Leggo! Hey! Leggo of me!

spans.text: Leggo! Hey! Leggo of me!

units.rawText: Chris kicks and punches the soldier holding him as he tries to struggle free and escape, even biting his captor and clawing at him.
units.displayText: Chris kicks and punches the soldier holding him as he tries to struggle free and escape, even biting his captor and clawing at him.

spans.text: Chris kicks and punches the soldier holding him as he tries to struggle free and escape, even biting his captor and clawing at him.

units.rawText: <size=40>Damn! This little shit's gone insane!</size>
units.displayText: Damn! This little shit's gone insane!

spans.text: Damn! This little shit's gone insane!

units.rawText: <size=40>Settle the hell down you little brat!</size>
units.displayText: Settle the hell down you little brat!

spans.text: Settle the hell down you little brat!

units.rawText: A gun butt thuds heavily into Chris' neck, and he goes limp. The soldiers tie him up and drag him back to the camp behind them.
units.displayText: A gun butt thuds heavily into Chris' neck, and he goes limp. The soldiers tie him up and drag him back to the camp behind them.

spans.text: A gun butt thuds heavily into Chris' neck, and he goes limp. The soldiers tie him up and drag him back to the camp behind them.

units.rawText: Beep-beep—
units.displayText: Beep-beep—

spans.text: Beep-beep—

units.rawText: Tony's face appears on the screen. He looks worried.
units.displayText: Tony's face appears on the screen. He looks worried.

spans.text: Tony's face appears on the screen. He looks worried.

units.rawText: Commander, something happened! I'm talking to you from the enemy base right now!
units.displayText: Commander, something happened! I'm talking to you from the enemy base right now!

spans.text: Commander, something happened! I'm talking to you from the enemy base right now!

units.rawText: Centaureissi and I exchange looks. I have a bad feeling about this.
units.displayText: Centaureissi and I exchange looks. I have a bad feeling about this.

spans.text: Centaureissi and I exchange looks. I have a bad feeling about this.

units.rawText: The enemy base... Tony, what happened?
units.displayText: The enemy base... Tony, what happened?

spans.text: The enemy base... Tony, what happened?

units.rawText: Chris was captured by the enemy. According to the patrolling soldiers, soldiers watching Lieutenant Izka's body picked him up. He's in an interrogation room now.
units.displayText: Chris was captured by the enemy. According to the patrolling soldiers, soldiers watching Lieutenant Izka's body picked him up. He's in an interrogation room now.

spans.text: Chris was captured by the enemy. According to the patrolling soldiers, soldiers watching Lieutenant Izka's body picked him up. He's in an interrogation room now.

units.rawText: I found a place without camera coverage and then I contacted you... What should I do next, Commander?
units.displayText: I found a place without camera coverage and then I contacted you... What should I do next, Commander?

spans.text: I found a place without camera coverage and then I contacted you... What should I do next, Commander?

units.rawText: Commander... We need to decide quickly.
units.displayText: Commander... We need to decide quickly.

spans.text: Commander... We need to decide quickly.

units.rawText: If we rescue him now, it might affect the upcoming infiltration operation, but Chris is in danger and...
units.displayText: If we rescue him now, it might affect the upcoming infiltration operation, but Chris is in danger and...

spans.text: If we rescue him now, it might affect the upcoming infiltration operation, but Chris is in danger and...

units.rawText: Centaureissi is clearly torn between emotion and duty. Much as she wants to carry out her responsibilities as a soldier, she doesn't want to see that person who reminds her so much of Vayne vanishing before her eyes again.
units.displayText: Centaureissi is clearly torn between emotion and duty. Much as she wants to carry out her responsibilities as a soldier, she doesn't want to see that person who reminds her so much of Vayne vanishing before her eyes again.

spans.text: Centaureissi is clearly torn between emotion and duty. Much as she wants to carry out her responsibilities as a soldier, she doesn't want to see that person who reminds her so much of Vayne vanishing before her eyes again.

units.rawText: I've memorized the plan and route. We can move up the start time with no problems.
units.displayText: I've memorized the plan and route. We can move up the start time with no problems.

spans.text: I've memorized the plan and route. We can move up the start time with no problems.

units.rawText: Relax, I'll take responsibility if HQ complains. Prepare for infiltration and rescue, Centaureissi.
units.displayText: Relax, I'll take responsibility if HQ complains. Prepare for infiltration and rescue, Centaureissi.

spans.text: Relax, I'll take responsibility if HQ complains. Prepare for infiltration and rescue, Centaureissi.

units.rawText: ...I don't intend to let the Lieutenant down. You think so too, right?
units.displayText: ...I don't intend to let the Lieutenant down. You think so too, right?

spans.text: ...I don't intend to let the Lieutenant down. You think so too, right?

units.rawText: A gleam appears in the girl's eyes.
units.displayText: A gleam appears in the girl's eyes.

spans.text: A gleam appears in the girl's eyes.

units.rawText: ...Yes, Commander! I'll get ready right now!
units.displayText: ...Yes, Commander! I'll get ready right now!

spans.text: ...Yes, Commander! I'll get ready right now!

units.rawText: What about me, Commander?
units.displayText: What about me, Commander?

spans.text: What about me, Commander?

units.rawText: Tony seems uneasy on the other side of the screen.
units.displayText: Tony seems uneasy on the other side of the screen.

spans.text: Tony seems uneasy on the other side of the screen.

units.rawText: I know about the kindness in the depths of his heart, but the danger before us is not something that a civilian Doll like him can handle.
units.displayText: I know about the kindness in the depths of his heart, but the danger before us is not something that a civilian Doll like him can handle.

spans.text: I know about the kindness in the depths of his heart, but the danger before us is not something that a civilian Doll like him can handle.

units.rawText: ...Commander?
units.displayText: ...Commander?

spans.text: ...Commander?

units.rawText: Tony, I would like you to act as you please going forward.
units.displayText: Tony, I would like you to act as you please going forward.

spans.text: Tony, I would like you to act as you please going forward.

units.rawText: But what does that mean, Commander? I don't understand!
units.displayText: But what does that mean, Commander? I don't understand!

spans.text: But what does that mean, Commander? I don't understand!

units.rawText: Right now, you are not one of my men. You are just an innocent civilian Doll who got caught up in the fighting... As such, I have no right and no desire to order you to do anything dangerous.
units.displayText: Right now, you are not one of my men. You are just an innocent civilian Doll who got caught up in the fighting... As such, I have no right and no desire to order you to do anything dangerous.

spans.text: Right now, you are not one of my men. You are just an innocent civilian Doll who got caught up in the fighting... As such, I have no right and no desire to order you to do anything dangerous.

units.rawText: Therefore I leave the decision to you, Tony. No matter what you choose, it will not change my opinion of you.
units.displayText: Therefore I leave the decision to you, Tony. No matter what you choose, it will not change my opinion of you.

spans.text: Therefore I leave the decision to you, Tony. No matter what you choose, it will not change my opinion of you.

units.rawText: The pink-haired Doll on the other side of the connection stares hard at me as he lapses into thought, and then he breaks into his trademark smile.
units.displayText: The pink-haired Doll on the other side of the connection stares hard at me as he lapses into thought, and then he breaks into his trademark smile.

spans.text: The pink-haired Doll on the other side of the connection stares hard at me as he lapses into thought, and then he breaks into his trademark smile.

units.rawText: ...I hope your team's got space for a hairdresser on it.
units.displayText: ...I hope your team's got space for a hairdresser on it.

spans.text: ...I hope your team's got space for a hairdresser on it.

units.rawText: We'll save you a slot.
units.displayText: We'll save you a slot.

spans.text: We'll save you a slot.

units.rawText: ...Now that is welcome news. See you later, Commander.
units.displayText: ...Now that is welcome news. See you later, Commander.

spans.text: ...Now that is welcome news. See you later, Commander.

units.rawText: Beep—
units.displayText: Beep—

spans.text: Beep—

units.rawText: Tony smiles and shuts off his communicator, silently rejoicing that the Commander did not see his trembling hands.
units.displayText: Tony smiles and shuts off his communicator, silently rejoicing that the Commander did not see his trembling hands.

spans.text: Tony smiles and shuts off his communicator, silently rejoicing that the Commander did not see his trembling hands.

units.rawText: I need to delay them and keep them from torturing Chris... I also need to buy the Commander and Centaureissi as much time as possible...
units.displayText: I need to delay them and keep them from torturing Chris... I also need to buy the Commander and Centaureissi as much time as possible...

spans.text: I need to delay them and keep them from torturing Chris... I also need to buy the Commander and Centaureissi as much time as possible...

units.rawText: Wait for me, Chris.
units.displayText: Wait for me, Chris.

spans.text: Wait for me, Chris.

units.rawText: Tony grabs his bag like a soldier holding his weapon and marches off to his own battlefield.
units.displayText: Tony grabs his bag like a soldier holding his weapon and marches off to his own battlefield.

spans.text: Tony grabs his bag like a soldier holding his weapon and marches off to his own battlefield.

units.rawText: In the enemy barracks.
units.displayText: In the enemy barracks.

spans.text: In the enemy barracks.

units.rawText: The barracks haven't been like this in a long time. There are countless off-duty soldiers of all ages lined up in front of an ordinary dorm room. The occasional passer-by walking down the corridor turns in curiosity to look inside.
units.displayText: The barracks haven't been like this in a long time. There are countless off-duty soldiers of all ages lined up in front of an ordinary dorm room. The occasional passer-by walking down the corridor turns in curiosity to look inside.

spans.text: The barracks haven't been like this in a long time. There are countless off-duty soldiers of all ages lined up in front of an ordinary dorm room. The occasional passer-by walking down the corridor turns in curiosity to look inside.

units.rawText: Oi, what's going on?
units.displayText: Oi, what's going on?

spans.text: Oi, what's going on?

units.rawText: Log Branch managed to get a barber for us so we can get haircuts. If you want one, get in line.
units.displayText: Log Branch managed to get a barber for us so we can get haircuts. If you want one, get in line.

spans.text: Log Branch managed to get a barber for us so we can get haircuts. If you want one, get in line.

units.rawText: The hairdresser with the brightly-colored hair amidst the crowd is now trimming the hair of an old soldier.
units.displayText: The hairdresser with the brightly-colored hair amidst the crowd is now trimming the hair of an old soldier.

spans.text: The hairdresser with the brightly-colored hair amidst the crowd is now trimming the hair of an old soldier.

units.rawText: Tch, Log Branch finally cleaned up their act. I haven't had my hair cut in two months. It gets in my eyes whenever I'm in the field.
units.displayText: Tch, Log Branch finally cleaned up their act. I haven't had my hair cut in two months. It gets in my eyes whenever I'm in the field.

spans.text: Tch, Log Branch finally cleaned up their act. I haven't had my hair cut in two months. It gets in my eyes whenever I'm in the field.

units.rawText: This is the first time I've let a Doll cut my hair, and frankly speaking, you're really good at this.
units.displayText: This is the first time I've let a Doll cut my hair, and frankly speaking, you're really good at this.

spans.text: This is the first time I've let a Doll cut my hair, and frankly speaking, you're really good at this.

units.rawText: A contented smile spreads over the face of the veteran. As the clippers run over his head, his hair that is so long that it had to be tied up falls down the hairdresser's cape, lock by lock.
units.displayText: A contented smile spreads over the face of the veteran. As the clippers run over his head, his hair that is so long that it had to be tied up falls down the hairdresser's cape, lock by lock.

spans.text: A contented smile spreads over the face of the veteran. As the clippers run over his head, his hair that is so long that it had to be tied up falls down the hairdresser's cape, lock by lock.

units.rawText: You flatter me. It's only natural that we treat frontliners the best. After all, you're the ones in the thick of it on the battlefield.
units.displayText: You flatter me. It's only natural that we treat frontliners the best. After all, you're the ones in the thick of it on the battlefield.

spans.text: You flatter me. It's only natural that we treat frontliners the best. After all, you're the ones in the thick of it on the battlefield.

units.rawText: Well, you would think of it that way. We've pinned the defenders in the city down to the point where they're powerless to resist. That's eased the pressure on us.
units.displayText: Well, you would think of it that way. We've pinned the defenders in the city down to the point where they're powerless to resist. That's eased the pressure on us.

spans.text: Well, you would think of it that way. We've pinned the defenders in the city down to the point where they're powerless to resist. That's eased the pressure on us.

units.rawText: Our lives are mainly patrols or chasing down fleeing defenders.
units.displayText: Our lives are mainly patrols or chasing down fleeing defenders.

spans.text: Our lives are mainly patrols or chasing down fleeing defenders.

units.rawText: Hm? I think I saw someone bringing a boy back to the camp. Was he one of the defenders too?
units.displayText: Hm? I think I saw someone bringing a boy back to the camp. Was he one of the defenders too?

spans.text: Hm? I think I saw someone bringing a boy back to the camp. Was he one of the defenders too?

units.rawText: Yeah right. His dad was a lieutenant on the other side. Dumb punk's probably locked up in a questioning room until the interrogator can get to him.
units.displayText: Yeah right. His dad was a lieutenant on the other side. Dumb punk's probably locked up in a questioning room until the interrogator can get to him.

spans.text: Yeah right. His dad was a lieutenant on the other side. Dumb punk's probably locked up in a questioning room until the interrogator can get to him.

units.rawText: There... He's in there.
units.displayText: There... He's in there.

spans.text: There... He's in there.

units.rawText: Tony looks where the veteran is pointing. There's a shack radiating a menacing aura in the corner of the camp that sends shivers down Tony's spine.
units.displayText: Tony looks where the veteran is pointing. There's a shack radiating a menacing aura in the corner of the camp that sends shivers down Tony's spine.

spans.text: Tony looks where the veteran is pointing. There's a shack radiating a menacing aura in the corner of the camp that sends shivers down Tony's spine.

units.rawText: Seriously, that interrogator's an old pervert, he gets drunk and then tortures people in horrible ways!
units.displayText: Seriously, that interrogator's an old pervert, he gets drunk and then tortures people in horrible ways!

spans.text: Seriously, that interrogator's an old pervert, he gets drunk and then tortures people in horrible ways!

units.rawText: ...So he hits the bottle hard, then?
units.displayText: ...So he hits the bottle hard, then?

spans.text: ...So he hits the bottle hard, then?

units.rawText: You have no idea, he's a regular old boozer. He doesn't even put the bottle down during interrogations, you have no idea how many problems that's caused!
units.displayText: You have no idea, he's a regular old boozer. He doesn't even put the bottle down during interrogations, you have no idea how many problems that's caused!

spans.text: You have no idea, he's a regular old boozer. He doesn't even put the bottle down during interrogations, you have no idea how many problems that's caused!

units.rawText: Worse still, he keeps eyeing our stuff! (Sigh) Looks like that bottle we just found and hid in the kitchen won't last until spring!
units.displayText: Worse still, he keeps eyeing our stuff! (Sigh) Looks like that bottle we just found and hid in the kitchen won't last until spring!

spans.text: Worse still, he keeps eyeing our stuff! (Sigh) Looks like that bottle we just found and hid in the kitchen won't last until spring!

units.rawText: I see...
units.displayText: I see...

spans.text: I see...

units.rawText: A plan appears in Tony's heart. Upon realizing this, his hands move quicker; once he finishes, he makes an excuse to sneak into the kitchen...
units.displayText: A plan appears in Tony's heart. Upon realizing this, his hands move quicker; once he finishes, he makes an excuse to sneak into the kitchen...

spans.text: A plan appears in Tony's heart. Upon realizing this, his hands move quicker; once he finishes, he makes an excuse to sneak into the kitchen...

units.rawText: In the interrogation room.
units.displayText: In the interrogation room.

spans.text: In the interrogation room.

units.rawText: Wreathed in alcoholic fumes, the interrogator holds a bottle in his hand and eyes the shackled boy.
units.displayText: Wreathed in alcoholic fumes, the interrogator holds a bottle in his hand and eyes the shackled boy.

spans.text: Wreathed in alcoholic fumes, the interrogator holds a bottle in his hand and eyes the shackled boy.

units.rawText: Hic! Chris Izka... Is that it? Your mother... died three years ago from a severe illness. So you've been following your dad around... Lieutenant Andrew Izka.
units.displayText: Hic! Chris Izka... Is that it? Your mother... died three years ago from a severe illness. So you've been following your dad around... Lieutenant Andrew Izka.

spans.text: Hic! Chris Izka... Is that it? Your mother... died three years ago from a severe illness. So you've been following your dad around... Lieutenant Andrew Izka.

units.rawText: ...Hic! Your father was a real pain in the ass... We lost like... dozens of men to get rid of him, fucker took his fair share of people with him...
units.displayText: ...Hic! Your father was a real pain in the ass... We lost like... dozens of men to get rid of him, fucker took his fair share of people with him...

spans.text: ...Hic! Your father was a real pain in the ass... We lost like... dozens of men to get rid of him, fucker took his fair share of people with him...

units.rawText: But that's the way things go, right?
units.displayText: But that's the way things go, right?

spans.text: But that's the way things go, right?

units.rawText: Before he died... Your dad apparently contacted Defender HQ. We're interested in knowing what he said.
units.displayText: Before he died... Your dad apparently contacted Defender HQ. We're interested in knowing what he said.

spans.text: Before he died... Your dad apparently contacted Defender HQ. We're interested in knowing what he said.

units.rawText: Chris says nothing, only glaring angrily at the interrogator. The man chuckles and takes a swig from his bottle.
units.displayText: Chris says nothing, only glaring angrily at the interrogator. The man chuckles and takes a swig from his bottle.

spans.text: Chris says nothing, only glaring angrily at the interrogator. The man chuckles and takes a swig from his bottle.

units.rawText: Hah, the last guy who eyeballed me like that got them gouged out and thrown into the snow.
units.displayText: Hah, the last guy who eyeballed me like that got them gouged out and thrown into the snow.

spans.text: Hah, the last guy who eyeballed me like that got them gouged out and thrown into the snow.

units.rawText: He smashes the bottle he's holding and reaches for a fragment as Chris watches in horror.
units.displayText: He smashes the bottle he's holding and reaches for a fragment as Chris watches in horror.

spans.text: He smashes the bottle he's holding and reaches for a fragment as Chris watches in horror.

units.rawText: Ah, his screams were great! I hope yours don't disappoint me...
units.displayText: Ah, his screams were great! I hope yours don't disappoint me...

spans.text: Ah, his screams were great! I hope yours don't disappoint me...

units.rawText: Knock knock knock—
units.displayText: Knock knock knock—

spans.text: Knock knock knock—

units.rawText: A series of hurried raps on the door interrupt the interrogator's excitement.
units.displayText: A series of hurried raps on the door interrupt the interrogator's excitement.

spans.text: A series of hurried raps on the door interrupt the interrogator's excitement.

units.rawText: <size=40>Who's the stupid bastard that's ruining my fun?!</size>
units.displayText: Who's the stupid bastard that's ruining my fun?!

spans.text: Who's the stupid bastard that's ruining my fun?!

units.rawText: An elegant male voice answers him.
units.displayText: An elegant male voice answers him.

spans.text: An elegant male voice answers him.

units.rawText: Greetings, sir. I'm the hairdresser sent by Log Branch. I was asked to attend to you today.
units.displayText: Greetings, sir. I'm the hairdresser sent by Log Branch. I was asked to attend to you today.

spans.text: Greetings, sir. I'm the hairdresser sent by Log Branch. I was asked to attend to you today.

units.rawText: Well, you can take a long walk off a short bridge! The further, the better!
units.displayText: Well, you can take a long walk off a short bridge! The further, the better!

spans.text: Well, you can take a long walk off a short bridge! The further, the better!

units.rawText: The interrogator grits his teeth in frustration and turns around, preparing to teach the person outside a lesson.
units.displayText: The interrogator grits his teeth in frustration and turns around, preparing to teach the person outside a lesson.

spans.text: The interrogator grits his teeth in frustration and turns around, preparing to teach the person outside a lesson.

units.rawText: He is met by Tony, whose eyes are twinkling to match his ingratiating smile. He has a huge pile of haircutting tools outside and a bottle of champagne in his hands.
units.displayText: He is met by Tony, whose eyes are twinkling to match his ingratiating smile. He has a huge pile of haircutting tools outside and a bottle of champagne in his hands.

spans.text: He is met by Tony, whose eyes are twinkling to match his ingratiating smile. He has a huge pile of haircutting tools outside and a bottle of champagne in his hands.

units.rawText: Oh, and did I forget to mention that Log Branch sent me over with a bottle of champagne as a reward for all your hard work?
units.displayText: Oh, and did I forget to mention that Log Branch sent me over with a bottle of champagne as a reward for all your hard work?

spans.text: Oh, and did I forget to mention that Log Branch sent me over with a bottle of champagne as a reward for all your hard work?

units.rawText: Upon hearing the familiar voice, Chris jerks his head toward the door.
units.displayText: Upon hearing the familiar voice, Chris jerks his head toward the door.

spans.text: Upon hearing the familiar voice, Chris jerks his head toward the door.

units.rawText: Oh, so they sent booze...
units.displayText: Oh, so they sent booze...

spans.text: Oh, so they sent booze...

units.rawText: The mention of alcohol causes the vicious look to fade from the man's face, and his initially suspicious gaze is now one of desire.
units.displayText: The mention of alcohol causes the vicious look to fade from the man's face, and his initially suspicious gaze is now one of desire.

spans.text: The mention of alcohol causes the vicious look to fade from the man's face, and his initially suspicious gaze is now one of desire.

units.rawText: Well come on in, then. Who knows what the hell those people in Log Branch are up to.
units.displayText: Well come on in, then. Who knows what the hell those people in Log Branch are up to.

spans.text: Well come on in, then. Who knows what the hell those people in Log Branch are up to.

units.rawText: Army Logistics asked me to give the soldiers a haircut. As you know, the situation's been tense for the past few months and everyone's only just been able to catch their breath recently.
units.displayText: Army Logistics asked me to give the soldiers a haircut. As you know, the situation's been tense for the past few months and everyone's only just been able to catch their breath recently.

spans.text: Army Logistics asked me to give the soldiers a haircut. As you know, the situation's been tense for the past few months and everyone's only just been able to catch their breath recently.

units.rawText: Yeah, and there's a big op coming up soon... We haven't been able to rest properly these past few days.
units.displayText: Yeah, and there's a big op coming up soon... We haven't been able to rest properly these past few days.

spans.text: Yeah, and there's a big op coming up soon... We haven't been able to rest properly these past few days.

units.rawText: The old drunk takes the bottle of champagne from Tony and soon becomes fascinated by it. While the man's attention is diverted, Tony winks to Chris and gestures to him to keep quiet.
units.displayText: The old drunk takes the bottle of champagne from Tony and soon becomes fascinated by it. While the man's attention is diverted, Tony winks to Chris and gestures to him to keep quiet.

spans.text: The old drunk takes the bottle of champagne from Tony and soon becomes fascinated by it. While the man's attention is diverted, Tony winks to Chris and gestures to him to keep quiet.

units.rawText: Not bad, they've got good taste in drinks...
units.displayText: Not bad, they've got good taste in drinks...

spans.text: Not bad, they've got good taste in drinks...

units.rawText: Thank you, sir. Now then, could you help me out regarding the haircut thing? I've got a quota to meet myself...
units.displayText: Thank you, sir. Now then, could you help me out regarding the haircut thing? I've got a quota to meet myself...

spans.text: Thank you, sir. Now then, could you help me out regarding the haircut thing? I've got a quota to meet myself...

units.rawText: The interrogator is clearly unhappy, but in the end he signals for Tony to enter anyway.
units.displayText: The interrogator is clearly unhappy, but in the end he signals for Tony to enter anyway.

spans.text: The interrogator is clearly unhappy, but in the end he signals for Tony to enter anyway.

units.rawText: Tony soon has his tools laid out on the table and invites the other man to sit down on the uncomfortable-looking chair.
units.displayText: Tony soon has his tools laid out on the table and invites the other man to sit down on the uncomfortable-looking chair.

spans.text: Tony soon has his tools laid out on the table and invites the other man to sit down on the uncomfortable-looking chair.

units.rawText: Make it quick. I still have to question this punk after this.
units.displayText: Make it quick. I still have to question this punk after this.

spans.text: Make it quick. I still have to question this punk after this.

units.rawText: Of course, sir.
units.displayText: Of course, sir.

spans.text: Of course, sir.

units.rawText: Tony lightly massages the man's face, and after he relaxes, he takes a towel out of the box he's carrying.
units.displayText: Tony lightly massages the man's face, and after he relaxes, he takes a towel out of the box he's carrying.

spans.text: Tony lightly massages the man's face, and after he relaxes, he takes a towel out of the box he's carrying.

units.rawText: Allow me to wipe your face with this hot towel.
units.displayText: Allow me to wipe your face with this hot towel.

spans.text: Allow me to wipe your face with this hot towel.

units.rawText: Humph, you pro Dolls are different after all. Back in my day, all we had was water and soap...
units.displayText: Humph, you pro Dolls are different after all. Back in my day, all we had was water and soap...

spans.text: Humph, you pro Dolls are different after all. Back in my day, all we had was water and soap...

units.rawText: The warm, damp cloth touches his darkened skin. The interrogator is only semi-conscious, but his long years of experience immediately allow him to sense the different smell coming from the towel.
units.displayText: The warm, damp cloth touches his darkened skin. The interrogator is only semi-conscious, but his long years of experience immediately allow him to sense the different smell coming from the towel.

spans.text: The warm, damp cloth touches his darkened skin. The interrogator is only semi-conscious, but his long years of experience immediately allow him to sense the different smell coming from the towel.

units.rawText: What the...?!
units.displayText: What the...?!

spans.text: What the...?!

units.rawText: Hrk!
units.displayText: Hrk!

spans.text: Hrk!

units.rawText: Tony does not panic just because he's been found out. He simply holds down the man's arms with his own to keep him from struggling while pressing the cloth tightly to the man's nose and mouth.
units.displayText: Tony does not panic just because he's been found out. He simply holds down the man's arms with his own to keep him from struggling while pressing the cloth tightly to the man's nose and mouth.

spans.text: Tony does not panic just because he's been found out. He simply holds down the man's arms with his own to keep him from struggling while pressing the cloth tightly to the man's nose and mouth.

units.rawText: <size=40>Mmmff... Mfffff... Mf!</size>
units.displayText: Mmmff... Mfffff... Mf!

spans.text: Mmmff... Mfffff... Mf!

units.rawText: The man's legs thrash in the air. Then, a moment later, they go completely still.
units.displayText: The man's legs thrash in the air. Then, a moment later, they go completely still.

spans.text: The man's legs thrash in the air. Then, a moment later, they go completely still.

units.rawText: (Pants) I didn't expect the ether from the safehouse to be so useful.
units.displayText: (Pants) I didn't expect the ether from the safehouse to be so useful.

spans.text: (Pants) I didn't expect the ether from the safehouse to be so useful.

units.rawText: The brief struggle just now was almost enough to overload his civilian neural cloud. After coming to his senses, Tony immediately moves up to Chris and frees him.
units.displayText: The brief struggle just now was almost enough to overload his civilian neural cloud. After coming to his senses, Tony immediately moves up to Chris and frees him.

spans.text: The brief struggle just now was almost enough to overload his civilian neural cloud. After coming to his senses, Tony immediately moves up to Chris and frees him.

units.rawText: Big Bro Tony, what are you doing here?
units.displayText: Big Bro Tony, what are you doing here?

spans.text: Big Bro Tony, what are you doing here?

units.rawText: Ow!
units.displayText: Ow!

spans.text: Ow!

units.rawText: Tony pinches Chris' cheeks in annoyance and sighs.
units.displayText: Tony pinches Chris' cheeks in annoyance and sighs.

spans.text: Tony pinches Chris' cheeks in annoyance and sighs.

units.rawText: I was chasing after you, of course... Look, I know you're sad about the Lieutenant, but you shouldn't...
units.displayText: I was chasing after you, of course... Look, I know you're sad about the Lieutenant, but you shouldn't...

spans.text: I was chasing after you, of course... Look, I know you're sad about the Lieutenant, but you shouldn't...

units.rawText: Tony can't go on after looking at the guilty expression on Chris' face.
units.displayText: Tony can't go on after looking at the guilty expression on Chris' face.

spans.text: Tony can't go on after looking at the guilty expression on Chris' face.

units.rawText: Eh, forget it. Not like it's going to help now, anyway.
units.displayText: Eh, forget it. Not like it's going to help now, anyway.

spans.text: Eh, forget it. Not like it's going to help now, anyway.

units.rawText: I can't leave the same way I came in with you around. All we can do is hope that the Commander and Centaureissi rescue us soon...
units.displayText: I can't leave the same way I came in with you around. All we can do is hope that the Commander and Centaureissi rescue us soon...

spans.text: I can't leave the same way I came in with you around. All we can do is hope that the Commander and Centaureissi rescue us soon...

units.rawText: Winter nights are always long. The cold rays of the morning sun have only just pierced the cloud cover but are halted outside the high walls of the camp.
units.displayText: Winter nights are always long. The cold rays of the morning sun have only just pierced the cloud cover but are halted outside the high walls of the camp.

spans.text: Winter nights are always long. The cold rays of the morning sun have only just pierced the cloud cover but are halted outside the high walls of the camp.

units.rawText: These spiked walls are over a dozen meters tall, and they are the first obstacle to infiltrating the camp. Thanks to Centaureissi's grappling hook and optical camouflage, we managed to silently bypass it.
units.displayText: These spiked walls are over a dozen meters tall, and they are the first obstacle to infiltrating the camp. Thanks to Centaureissi's grappling hook and optical camouflage, we managed to silently bypass it.

spans.text: These spiked walls are over a dozen meters tall, and they are the first obstacle to infiltrating the camp. Thanks to Centaureissi's grappling hook and optical camouflage, we managed to silently bypass it.

units.rawText: Tony sent a set of coordinates. He said he found Chris and the two of them are in the interrogation room. They're safe for now.
units.displayText: Tony sent a set of coordinates. He said he found Chris and the two of them are in the interrogation room. They're safe for now.

spans.text: Tony sent a set of coordinates. He said he found Chris and the two of them are in the interrogation room. They're safe for now.

units.rawText: Send them a message. Tell them to stay put and not alert the enemy. We'll head over and meet up with them.
units.displayText: Send them a message. Tell them to stay put and not alert the enemy. We'll head over and meet up with them.

spans.text: Send them a message. Tell them to stay put and not alert the enemy. We'll head over and meet up with them.

units.rawText: Yes, sir.
units.displayText: Yes, sir.

spans.text: Yes, sir.

units.rawText: Shh! Someone's coming...
units.displayText: Shh! Someone's coming...

spans.text: Shh! Someone's coming...

units.rawText: Centaureissi senses the enemy approaching and doubles back, pushing me into a little storeroom nearby.
units.displayText: Centaureissi senses the enemy approaching and doubles back, pushing me into a little storeroom nearby.

spans.text: Centaureissi senses the enemy approaching and doubles back, pushing me into a little storeroom nearby.

units.rawText: Just as we finish hiding ourselves, several soldiers enter the warehouse and offload several cartloads of cargo and tools.
units.displayText: Just as we finish hiding ourselves, several soldiers enter the warehouse and offload several cartloads of cargo and tools.

spans.text: Just as we finish hiding ourselves, several soldiers enter the warehouse and offload several cartloads of cargo and tools.

units.rawText: Are they moving something into the warehouse?
units.displayText: Are they moving something into the warehouse?

spans.text: Are they moving something into the warehouse?

units.rawText: Hurry up! Don't drag your feet... These shells are going to be shipped out soon.
units.displayText: Hurry up! Don't drag your feet... These shells are going to be shipped out soon.

spans.text: Hurry up! Don't drag your feet... These shells are going to be shipped out soon.

units.rawText: Relax, man, it's not like we can move such a huge batch at once.
units.displayText: Relax, man, it's not like we can move such a huge batch at once.

spans.text: Relax, man, it's not like we can move such a huge batch at once.

units.rawText: Come off it, if you can't do it, they'll find someone who can. We wouldn't even have to use a clumsy reprobate like you if it wasn't because we can't drive the transport trucks into the armory.
units.displayText: Come off it, if you can't do it, they'll find someone who can. We wouldn't even have to use a clumsy reprobate like you if it wasn't because we can't drive the transport trucks into the armory.

spans.text: Come off it, if you can't do it, they'll find someone who can. We wouldn't even have to use a clumsy reprobate like you if it wasn't because we can't drive the transport trucks into the armory.

units.rawText: Chill out, man, I'm moving it, aren't I? (Groan) Why did they have to expedite this operation, it's such a pain...
units.displayText: Chill out, man, I'm moving it, aren't I? (Groan) Why did they have to expedite this operation, it's such a pain...

spans.text: Chill out, man, I'm moving it, aren't I? (Groan) Why did they have to expedite this operation, it's such a pain...

units.rawText: The soldiers' grumbling gets my attention. After they leave, I stick my head out and check on the nature of the weapons they're moving.
units.displayText: The soldiers' grumbling gets my attention. After they leave, I stick my head out and check on the nature of the weapons they're moving.

spans.text: The soldiers' grumbling gets my attention. After they leave, I stick my head out and check on the nature of the weapons they're moving.

units.rawText: Commander? What just happened? Why do you have that look on your face?
units.displayText: Commander? What just happened? Why do you have that look on your face?

spans.text: Commander? What just happened? Why do you have that look on your face?

units.rawText: Because the worst has come to pass.
units.displayText: Because the worst has come to pass.

spans.text: Because the worst has come to pass.

units.rawText: I smile bitterly as I organize my thoughts and explain the situation.
units.displayText: I smile bitterly as I organize my thoughts and explain the situation.

spans.text: I smile bitterly as I organize my thoughts and explain the situation.

units.rawText: <color=red>...Looks like they're planning to level the city.</color>
units.displayText: ...Looks like they're planning to level the city.

spans.text: ...Looks like they're planning to level the city.

units.rawText: The snow slowly melts under the sunlight, revealing the soldiers buried within the grass.
units.displayText: The snow slowly melts under the sunlight, revealing the soldiers buried within the grass.

spans.text: The snow slowly melts under the sunlight, revealing the soldiers buried within the grass.

units.rawText: If the rescue will affect any subsequent infiltration missions, then we'll just begin the infiltration now and work the rescue into the plan.
units.displayText: If the rescue will affect any subsequent infiltration missions, then we'll just begin the infiltration now and work the rescue into the plan.

spans.text: If the rescue will affect any subsequent infiltration missions, then we'll just begin the infiltration now and work the rescue into the plan.
